name: layouts
description: A reusable canvas with freeform areas, catalog views and optional coordinated pages, owned by a company or one branch.
lifecycle: Created by members or imported from its JSON representation; every save of the definition or name bumps the version. Deleted at runtime with its areas and pages. The owning scope never changes. See docs/project/catalog-composition-design.md#layouts.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the layout; immutable (tenant key).
Branch that owns the layout; immutable.
columns.Null meaning: The layout belongs to the whole company.

columns.Meaning: Display name chosen by members, trimmed, 1 to 120 characters.
Whether members confirmed that more than one area plays sound at once.
PostgreSQL-clock instant of the last change.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, branch_id) REFERENCES branches(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The owning branch belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: A layout belongs to an existing company.
Names are trimmed and not empty.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX layouts_company_created_idx ON public.layouts USING btree (company_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
constraints.Purpose: Lists a company's layouts newest first with keyset cursors.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX layouts_company_id_id_key ON public.layouts USING btree (company_id, id)
